name: Thymosin alpha-1
description: Synthetic 28-amino-acid peptide, same structure as natural thymosin alpha-1 from thymus tissue

note.text: It is an immune drug. No trial has tested it for muscle or injury recovery.

bullets: **Acts on immune cells,** especially lymphocytes, per the Italian label
**Not a muscle or tissue-repair drug** in its approved use
Sepsis trial, 1,106 people: no effect on death rates
US hepatitis B Phase 3: benefit not confirmed
No trials for muscle or injury recovery

practical.pharmacokinetics: Peak about 6 hours after injection; baseline within 24 hours
practical.soldAs: Prescription injection in Italy (Zadaxin); not approved in the US
practical.monitored: 28-day deaths, hepatitis B virus markers, liver enzymes

regulatory.text: Not in the Oct 2026 peptide compounding policy

references: AIFA, Zadaxin summary of product characteristics, Feb 2026
Wu J, et al., BMJ, TESTS sepsis trial, Jan 2025
FDA, bulk drug substances with significant safety risks (Category 2), Apr 2026
